subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, Thank you for your recent purchase with our online store. We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in processing your order due to high demand. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to fulfill your order as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and understanding in this matter. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs.
